title: Sign for a Collapse Risk Area (Related to Article 5)
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rule of the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters Act [Attached Table 1] <Amended 2017.7.3>

Sign for a Collapse Risk Area (Related to Article 5)

| Sign for a collapse risk area | Instructions for installing the sign |
|---|---|
| Illustration: a rectangular signboard mounted on a vertical post. | 1. Dimensions: (a) Signboard: 1.2 m (width) × 1 m (height). (b) The sign may be installed without a post, taking account of conditions at the site. However, where a post is to be installed, its diameter shall be at least 10 cm. |
| | 2. Material: Both the signboard and the post shall be made of iron, aluminum, or a similar material. |
| | 3. Color: (a) Background (signboard and post): Yellow. (b) Lettering: Black, except that "Collapse Risk Area" shall be in red. (c) The sign shall be made so that it is readily visible at night as well. |
